name: gatsby-plugin-yatmo
description: Add real estate maps, points of interest and neighbourhood data to Gatsby sites: the plugin loads the Yatmo web components and declares your key once, and re-exports the YatmoMap, YatmoPois and YatmoNeighbourhoodText React components for property pages. The official Gatsby plugin for Yatmo.

scripts.build: node --check gatsby-ssr.js && node --check gatsby-node.js && node --check index.js

author: Yatmo (https://yatmo.com)
